title: He didn’t die.
paragraphs: Because everyone else in that chapter did.
Enoch walked with God… and then he was gone.
But here’s the part that should shake you:
What did Enoch have… that others didn’t?
Because if you read the world he lived in—
The kind of world where compromise was normal…
And if we’re even more honest—
sometimes that world lives in us.
Secret sins we’ve learned to manage instead of surrender.
The version of you that smiles in public…
That’s where Enoch’s story hits different.
Because Scripture doesn’t say he was perfect.
Genesis 5:24 — “Enoch walked with God; then he was no more, because God took him.”
And the New Testament pulls back the curtain even more:
Hebrews 11:5 — “By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death… for before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.”
But here’s where it gets uncomfortable:
What does it mean to “walk with God”…
“If I still struggle, I must not be close to Him.”
Walking with God doesn’t mean you never fall.
It means you refuse to stay fallen.
You bring it into the light.
1 John 1:7 — “If we walk in the light, as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus… purifies us from all sin.”
Because secret sin grows in silence…
And here’s the truth most people avoid:
You don’t lose intimacy with God overnight.
One hidden decision at a time.
In a generation drowning in darkness—
Enoch is not the hero of the story.
And that’s why you need more than a walk.
Romans 3:23 — “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.”
That includes every hidden thought, every secret habit, every silent compromise.
And no amount of effort can fix that gap.
So God did what we couldn’t.
Romans 5:8 — “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.”
Jesus didn’t wait for you to clean up.
He lived the perfect life you couldn’t live.
He carried the sin you didn’t want exposed.
He took the punishment you deserved.
So you wouldn’t have to be separated from God forever.
1 Corinthians 15:4 — “He was buried, and He was raised on the third day…”
2 Corinthians 5:17 — “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation…”
You can’t cling to secret sin—
And let Jesus do what you never could—
cleanse you. restore you. transform you.
You don’t need to vanish like Enoch…
You need to come to Jesus.
